goal: ballotwatch.io's public pages load clean for a visitor: no page errors, no failed same-origin requests, no broken internal links, no horizontal overflow on phones, sound document structure. Data correctness and political content are out of scope.
repo_notes: React 18 + Vite SPA with Vercel functions. Read CLAUDE.md and DESIGN.md first. public/openapi.yaml is generated; never edit it. Gated pages are listed once in shared/access.js; do not touch access rules. Record routes are prerendered by api/prerender.js.

approval.basis: Owner approved on 2026-10-10: the loop may propose fixes to Ballot Watch as pull requests only; nothing merges or deploys without the owner.
